lifecycle_stages.name: Sandbox Creation
lifecycle_stages.description: Create an isolated persistent Celesto cloud computer and capture its computer ID.

lifecycle_stages.name: Runtime Provisioning
lifecycle_stages.description: Check and install Python 3 when required.

lifecycle_stages.name: Task Execution
lifecycle_stages.description: Execute the approved task inside the Celesto sandbox.

lifecycle_stages.name: Result Collection
lifecycle_stages.description: Capture execution output, exit code, and streaming metadata.

lifecycle_stages.name: Stop Persistent Sandbox
lifecycle_stages.description: Stop the persistent computer while retaining its identity for later reconnection.

lifecycle_stages.name: Resume Persistent Sandbox
lifecycle_stages.description: Reconnect to the same Celesto computer using its stored computer ID and verify command execution.

lifecycle_stages.name: Persistent Sandbox Deletion
lifecycle_stages.description: Delete the persistent computer through the API.

lifecycle_stages.name: Cleanup Verification
lifecycle_stages.description: Verify that the Celesto dashboard has zero active sandboxes after deletion.
